druid.name: Nature's Grasp / Natural Shapeshifter
druid.summary: Focus on 100% proc chance Nature's Grasp, 2 in Furor for 40% chance to generate rage on shapeshift. Furor gains combat. Natural Shapeshifter is strong, shapeshifting is your bread and butter.

druid.name: Nature's Grasp / Improved Entangling Roots
druid.summary: Full Nature's Grasp, Natural Shapeshifter, and 70% chance to ignore pushback on root cast.
druid.points: 5/5 Nature's Grasp, 3/3 Natural Shapeshifter, 2/3 Improved Entangling Roots

hunter.name: Deflection / Improved Wing Clip
hunter.summary: +5% parry chance, 20% chance to proc root on Wing Clip. Spammable.

hunter.name: Concussive / Humanoid Slaying control
hunter.note: The source doc omitted this build's point line; ranks below are derived from the effect text and the talent-calc link.
hunter.summary: 8% chance to proc stun on Concussive Shot, 3% increased damage to humanoids, +2% parry chance, 12% chance to proc root on Wing Clip.
hunter.points: 2/5 Improved Concussive Shot, 3/3 Humanoid Slaying, 2/5 Deflection, 3/5 Improved Wing Clip

hunter.name: Concussive / Lethal Shots
hunter.summary: +5% crit chance, 20% chance to proc stun on Concussive Shot, fatal against flag carriers who easily shapeshift out of slows and roots (although at a detriment to mana).

hunter.name: Improved Aspect of the Hawk / Concussive
hunter.summary: 5% chance to increase attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds. Makes Venomstrike 1.5 speed on horde, and 1.49 speed on alliance (10% (11% alliance) quiver, 30% proc), 20% chance to proc stun on Concussive Shot.
hunter.points: 5/5 Improved Aspect of the Hawk, 5/5 Improved Concussive Shot

mage.name: Frost / Frostbite
mage.summary: Targets lose 5 resistance to your spells (negates cloak enchant), 2% hit for arcane, frost, and fire, -.5 seconds on Frostbolt cast time, 10% chance to proc root on all slows.
mage.points: 1/2 Arcane Subtlety, 1/5 Arcane Focus, 5/5 Improved Frostbolt, 1/3 Elemental Precision, 2/3 Frostbite

mage.name: Frost / Improved Frost Nova
mage.summary: Targets lose 5 resistance to your spells (negates cloak enchant), 2% hit for arcane, frost, and fire, -.5 seconds on Frostbolt cast time, 21 sec cooldown for Frost Nova instead of 25 sec. If you are making 4 seconds impactful, very strong.
mage.points: 1/2 Arcane Subtlety, 1/5 Arcane Focus, 5/5 Improved Frostbolt, 1/3 Elemental Precision, 2/2 Improved Frost Nova

mage.name: Fire / Impact
mage.summary: Targets lose 5 resistance to your spells (negates cloak enchant), 2% hit for arcane, frost, and fire, -.5 seconds on Fireball cast time, 2% chance to proc stun on fire spell, increased range of fire spells by 6 yards.
mage.points: 1/2 Arcane Subtlety, 1/5 Arcane Focus, 4/5 Improved Fireball, 1/5 Impact, 2/2 Flame Throwing, 1/3 Elemental Precision

mage.name: Arcane Missiles / Wand
mage.summary: Targets lose 5 resistance to your spells (negates cloak enchant), 2% hit for arcane, frost, and fire, 100% chance to ignore pushback on Arcane Missiles cast, 25% increased wand damage.
mage.points: 1/2 Arcane Subtlety, 1/5 Arcane Focus, 5/5 Improved Arcane Missiles, 2/2 Wand Specialization, 1/3 Elemental Precision

paladin.name: Redoubt / Toughness
paladin.summary: 30% chance to block for 5 blocks or 10 seconds when you are a victim to a crit, -2 minutes cooldown on Blessing of Protection, +6 seconds on Blessing of Freedom Duration, 6% increased armor from items.

paladin.name: Redoubt / Precision
paladin.summary: 30% chance to block for 5 blocks or 10 seconds when you are a victim to a crit, -2 minutes cooldown on Blessing of Protection, +6 seconds on Blessing of Freedom Duration, 3% melee hit chance (hoj is not on melee hit table).

priest.name: Blackout / Renew
priest.summary: 70% chance to ignore pushback on healing spells, 10% increase to BASE Renew healing, 10% chance to proc stun on shadow spell applications (Mind Blast, Power Word: Shadow APPLICATION, not DOT, Touch of Weakness, NOT Hex of Weakness), 2% Shadow hit (benefits Psychic Scream).
priest.points: 2/2 Healing Focus, 1/3 Improved Renew, 5/5 Blackout, 1/5 Shadow Focus

priest.name: Unbreakable Will / Martyrdom
priest.summary: 15% Stun, Fear, Silence resist chance, 100% chance to ignore pushback on all spells for 6 seconds when you are a victim to a crit, 70% chance to ignore pushback on healing spells, 2% chance to proc stun on shadow spell applications (Mind Blast, Power Word: Shadow APPLICATION, not DOT, Touch of Weakness, NOT Hex of Weakness).
priest.points: 5/5 Unbreakable Will, 2/2 Martyrdom, 2/2 Healing Focus, 1/5 Blackout

priest.name: Divine Fury / Renew
priest.summary: 70% chance to ignore pushback on healing spells, 30% increase to BASE Renew healing, -.5 seconds on Heal cast time (just Heal, not Lesser Heal).
priest.points: 2/2 Healing Focus, 3/3 Improved Renew, 5/5 Divine Fury

priest.name: Wand / Blackout
priest.summary: 25% increased Wand damage, 10% chance to proc stun on shadow spell applications (Mind Blast, Power Word: Shadow APPLICATION, not DOT, Touch of Weakness, NOT Hex of Weakness).

rogue.name: Improved Gouge / Precision
rogue.summary: +1.5 seconds on Gouge duration, -5 energy for Sinister Strike, 5% melee hit chance.
rogue.points: 3/3 Improved Gouge, 2/2 Improved Sinister Strike, 5/5 Precision

rogue.name: Improved Gouge / Master of Deception
rogue.summary: +1.5 seconds on Gouge duration, 15 points of Stealth Effectiveness (3 levels, Human Perception is 10 levels or 50 points, this will reduce power of Perception by 30%), 6% increased speed in Stealth (56% speed instead of 50%).
rogue.points: 3/3 Improved Gouge, 5/5 Master of Deception, 2/5 Camouflage

shaman.name: Convection / Earth's Grasp
shaman.summary: 10% reduced mana cost on Shocks and Lightning Bolt, 20% increased radius of Earthbind (12 yard radius range, 24 yard diameter range), -.3 seconds on Healing Wave cast time.
shaman.points: 5/5 Convection, 2/2 Earth's Grasp, 3/5 Improved Healing Wave

shaman.name: Concussion / Earth's Grasp
shaman.summary: 10% increased BASE damage on Shocks and Lightning Bolt, 20% increased radius of Earthbind (12 yard radius range, 24 yard diameter range), -.3 seconds on Healing Wave cast time.
shaman.points: 5/5 Concussion, 2/2 Earth's Grasp, 3/5 Improved Healing Wave

shaman.name: Convection / Improved Healing Wave
shaman.summary: 10% reduced mana cost on Shocks and Lightning Bolt, -.5 seconds on Healing Wave cast time.

shaman.name: Shield Specialization / Improved Healing Wave
shaman.summary: +5% chance to block and +25% increased amount blocked, -.5 seconds on Healing Wave cast time. Tanky healing-support loadout that trades offense for survivability and cast-under-pressure heals as a flag carrier.

warlock.name: Improved Corruption / Life Tap
warlock.summary: 2% Affliction hit chance (Fear affected), -2 seconds Corruption cast time (now instant), 20% increased mana from mana tap (81.6 instead of 68), 20% increased health restored by Healthstone (300 instead of 250).
warlock.points: 1/5 Suppression, 5/5 Improved Corruption, 2/2 Improved Life Tap, 2/2 Improved Healthstone

warrior.name: Deflection / Tactical Mastery
warrior.summary: +5% chance to Parry, 3 increased Rage from Charge (12 instead of 9), ability to retain 20 rage when swapping stances (enough to insta disarm).

warrior.name: Anticipation / Iron Will
warrior.summary: +10 Defense skill (.4% chance to be missed, dodge, block, and .4% less chance to be crit, .2% less chance to be crit against those with +5 weapon skill.), 15% increased chance to resist Stun and Charm effects.
